title: Apple Spiced Martini
ldInstructionsRaw: Rim a glass with the sugar and set aside. Combine all of the ingredients in a shaker and shake with ice to chill. Strain into the prepared glass and garnish with the apple ribbon.

Apple-Spiced Simple SyrupCombine 1 tsp. of ground cinnamon, 1 tsp. of ground ginger, 1 tsp. of ground allspice, 1 tsp. of ground nutmeg, 1 cup of granulated sugar, 1 slice of a red apple, 1/4-inch thick, and 1/2 cup water in a small saucepan, bring to a boil and stir to combine. Remove from heat and let cool to room temperature. Double strain into an airtight container and keep refrigerated for up to two weeks.
